content: संयोगः .²1 .³({%a%}) Conjunction, union, combination, junction, association, intimate union; संयोगो हि वियोगस्य संसूचयति संभवम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .³({%b%}) Endowment with, possession of. .²2 Conjunction (as one of the 24 guṇas of the Vaiśeṣikas). .²3 Addition, annexation. .²4 A set; आभरणसंयोगाः <ls>Māl. 6</ls>. .²5 Alliance between two kings for a common object. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A conjunct consonant; हलोऽनन्तराः संयोगः <ls>P. I. 1. 7</ls>. .²7 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) The conjunction of two heavenly bodies. .²8 An epithet of Śiva. .²9 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) Contact (direct material). .²10 Carnal contact. .²11 Matrimonial relation. .²12 Agreement of opinion. .²13 Sum, total amount.
